name: runlease
description: Lease short-lived cloud spot machines in your own account: launch, run commands, copy files, delete.
long_description:
Runlease launches a spot machine in your own GCP or AWS account, reaches it through a relay that cannot read the session, and deletes it when its lease ends. This bundle runs `runlease mcp`, which gives an MCP client typed tools to launch a machine, run a command on it, copy files, extend the lease and delete it.

The server uses the same sign-in, config and cloud credentials as the `runlease` CLI. Set those up in a terminal first: see https://github.com/marshal-org/runlease/blob/main/docs/mcp.md. Machines are billed to your own cloud account until they are deleted.

tools.name: runlease_status
tools.description: Who is signed in, how many machine slots are in use, and the machines this computer tracks. Read-only.

tools.name: runlease_up
tools.description: Launch a spot machine in your own cloud account. Returns at once, without waiting for boot.

tools.name: runlease_exec
tools.description: Run a shell command on a machine and return its exit code, stdout and stderr.

tools.name: runlease_push
tools.description: Copy one local file to a machine.

tools.name: runlease_pull
tools.description: Copy one file from a machine to this computer.

tools.name: runlease_list
tools.description: List the machines this computer tracks, as JSON. Read-only.

tools.name: runlease_snooze
tools.description: Set a machine's self-deletion to a duration from now.

tools.name: runlease_down
tools.description: Delete a machine now, with its disk and everything on it.

tools.name: runlease_doctor
tools.description: Check that this computer can launch machines and report what to fix. Read-only.
